met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over northeast Madhya Pradesh & adjoining Chhattisgarh lies over north Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood at 0530 hrs IST of today, 10th August, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Jaisalmer, Guna, centre of Low Pressure Area over north Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood, Daltonganj, Digha and thence southeastwards into the Eastcentral Bay of Bengal and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 65°E to the north of Lat. 30°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Madhya Maharashtraat 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over northwest Bay of Bengal & neighbourhood and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level. Under its influence, a Low Pressure Area is likely to form over the same region around 13th August, 2026.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Central Assam extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
